name: Deer
otherStatistics: STR +0, DEX +3, CON +0, INT -4, WIS +2, CHA -3. Perception 16. Stealth 13. Senses —. Languages —.
appearance: A reddish-brown stag with a pale throat and broad branching antlers.

sections.Printed source: Nosolorol, Cubil de Monstruos (licensed Spanish edition of Kobold Press’s Monster Vault), p. 339, “Ciervo”.
sections.Vulnerabilities: Frightened. The deer has disadvantage on checks and saves to avoid or end the condition.
sections.Actions: Kick. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. The hit deals 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller target must pass a DC 10 Strength save or fall prone.
sections.Bonus Actions: Skittish. Take the Dash or Disengage action.

name: Dinosaur, Ankylosaurus
otherStatistics: Natural armor. STR +4, DEX +0, CON +2, INT -4, WIS +1, CHA -3. Perception 11. Stealth 10. Senses —. Languages —.
appearance: A low-slung, armored dinosaur with a spiked back and a heavy tail club.

sections.Printed source: Nosolorol, Cubil de Monstruos (licensed Spanish edition of Kobold Press’s Monster Vault), pp. 108–109, “Anquilosaurio”.
sections.Traits: Hardy. Treat any critical hit against the dinosaur as a normal hit.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Tail attacks.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. The hit deals 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 14 Strength save or fall prone.
Tail Sweep (Recharge 4–6). Every creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage, is pushed up to 15 ft. away and falls prone. A successful save halves the damage and prevents the push and prone effects. After use, roll a d6 at the start of each ankylosaurus turn. A 4–6 restores the action. A short or long rest also restores it.
sections.Reactions: Defensive Huddle. When a creature the ankylosaurus can see hits it with a weapon attack, the ankylosaurus turns its armored back into the blow and halves the damage it takes from the attack.

name: Dinosaur, Plesiosaurus
otherStatistics: Natural armor. STR +4, DEX +2, CON +3, INT -4, WIS +1, CHA -3. Perception 13. Stealth 14. Senses —. Languages —.
appearance: A dark blue-gray marine reptile with a long curved neck and four paddle-like flippers.

sections.Printed source: Nosolorol, Cubil de Monstruos (licensed Spanish edition of Kobold Press’s Monster Vault), p. 109, “Plesiosaurio”.
sections.Traits:
Hardy. Treat any critical hit against the dinosaur as a normal hit.
Hold Breath. The plesiosaurus can hold its breath for 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Flipper Slam. While underwater, the plesiosaurus sends a shock wave through the water in a 15-ft. cone. Each creature in the cone must pass a DC 13 Constitution save or be off-balance until the end of its next turn. While off-balance, the creature has half speed and disadvantage on its first attack roll on each of its turns.

name: Dinosaur, Triceratops
otherStatistics: Natural armor. STR +6, DEX -1, CON +3, INT -4, WIS +0, CHA -3. Perception 10. Stealth 9. Senses —. Languages —.
appearance: A stocky gray-brown dinosaur with three facial horns and a broad neck frill.

sections.Printed source: Nosolorol, Cubil de Monstruos (licensed Spanish edition of Kobold Press’s Monster Vault), pp. 109–110, “Triceratops”.
sections.Traits:
Hardy. Treat any critical hit against the dinosaur as a normal hit.
Trampling Charge. If the triceratops moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with Gore on the same turn, the target must pass a DC 14 Strength save or fall prone. If the target is prone, the triceratops can make a Stomp attack against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Gore attacks.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. A hit deals 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Warning Bugle. Each creature in a 30-ft. cone must pass a DC 14 Wisdom save or be frightened until the end of its next turn. If the triceratops uses Warning Bugle before the 20 ft. of movement for Trampling Charge, its charge target has disadvantage on this Wisdom save. If that target fails the charge’s Strength save, the triceratops can Stomp the prone target without spending a bonus action.

name: Dinosaur, Tyrannosaurus Rex
otherStatistics: Natural armor. STR +8, DEX +0, CON +4, INT -4, WIS +1, CHA -1. Perception 14. Stealth 10. Senses —. Languages —.
appearance: An ochre-brown bipedal dinosaur with massive jaws, short forelimbs and a long tail.

sections.Printed source: Nosolorol, Cubil de Monstruos (licensed Spanish edition of Kobold Press’s Monster Vault), pp. 110–111, “Tyrannosaurus Rex”.
sections.Traits: Hardy. Treat any critical hit against the dinosaur as a normal hit.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail attack against different targets.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 31 (4d12 + 5) piercing damage. A Large or smaller target is automatically grappled and remains restrained until the grapple ends. The target can use its action to try to escape (DC 16). While the grapple lasts, the tyrannosaurus cannot Bite another target.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Rending Shake. One creature grappled by the tyrannosaurus must pass a DC 16 Strength save or take 6 (1d12) slashing damage, be thrown up to 20 ft. in a random direction and fall prone. If the thrown target strikes a solid surface, it takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 ft. it was thrown. If it is thrown at another creature, that other creature must pass a DC 16 Dexterity save or take the same bludgeoning damage and fall prone.
